$description: PRES Party Game design tokens — W3C DTCG format. Deep indigo/navy surfaces, coral primary (FF6B4A), violet secondary (5328FC), Inter typography, 16px radius. Dark is the app's native nightlife aesthetic; light is a warm-white complement. Edit values here only — the dev server regenerates src/index.css and src/generated/tokens.tsx via scripts/build-tokens.mjs.

background.$description: Warm white with a faint lavender tint — the light-mode page canvas.

foreground.$description: Deep indigo text — the app's dominant dark hue used as foreground in light mode.

primary.$description: Coral — the PRES brand accent used on CTA buttons, links, and highlights.

secondary.$description: Violet — secondary actions, toggles, and active-state fills.

accent.$description: Coral accent — same as primary; PRES uses one vivid accent colour.

background.$description: Deep indigo — the PRES app's signature nightlife page canvas.

card.$description: Violet card surface — used by game cards and content panels.

primary.$description: Coral — CTA buttons (Play, Continue), links, and emphasis elements.

secondary.$description: Violet — secondary actions and toggle active states.

muted.$description: Dark purple — muted surface beneath cards and input fields.

mutedForeground.$description: Lavender — sub-labels, captions, and disabled text.

destructive.$description: Hot pink-red — danger states and loser-fate highlights.

input.$description: Approximates rgba(255,255,255,0.12) on #140B4A — input border fill.

chart5.$description: Lime — library badge and Edgy theme accent.

sans.$description: Inter — the sole typeface in the PRES app, loaded via @expo-google-fonts/inter.

base.$description: 16 px base radius — matches the PRES app's cornerRadius constant. Pill buttons use borderRadius:99; derive sm/md/lg/xl from this base.
